review.images: Residence and amenity renders extracted from the official brochure for Al Ghadeer Gardens. Aldar uses some shared neighbourhood, elevation and interior art across both Gardens brochures. Shared facilities are labelled as such and the card uses this release’s selected lead view.
review.location: Visually checked all four estimates on physical page 6 of this release’s brochure. The same schematic appears in both releases. The map shows area connections via Al Fayah Road and does not locate individual gates.
review.floorPlans: Four complete sheets on physical pages 40–43 reviewed. The launch brochure includes the three-bedroom middle townhouse on page 41. Its two-bedroom townhouse on page 40 has no middle or corner designation. No signed area is printed beside the individual drawings.

unavailable: Verified entrance coordinates and unit-specific signed total areas.
